COG.note: ISO member page states nothing on a national data policy.

facts.fact: The ISO member page lists ACONOQ as a member body of ISO and an Affiliate Plus member of the IEC, participating in 2 ISO technical committees and 3 project committees.
facts.system: Agence Congolaise de Normalisation et de la Qualité (ACONOQ)

facts.fact: The ISO member page says ACONOQ was created by Law No. 19-2015 of 29 October 2015 as the national standardization body, managing the national standards register.
facts.system: Agence Congolaise de Normalisation et de la Qualité (ACONOQ)
